posts.text: Liquid Glass Kit 0.9: same glass, less idle work. Mounting 100 static controllers: 1.70 → 0.90ms (47% less time; Chrome 152; 31 paired runs). Zero static input listeners, resize observers or RAFs. Same APIs. Demo + raw evidence: https://wpsydev.github.io/liquid-glass-kit/performance/

Scope: synchronous elapsed time, not FPS. Full static lifecycle: 3.70 → 2.20ms. Source: 1,567 → 1,561 lines. Library files: 47% smaller mainly from removing unusable maps; client JS grew slightly. 104 tests pass. Reproduce: https://github.com/wpsydev/liquid-glass-kit/blob/main/docs/PERFORMANCE.md

0.9.0-preview.1 is on GitHub: npm i github:wpsydev/liquid-glass-kit#v0.9.0-preview.1. Start with one CSS class; add motion when needed. Same options/update/destroy API, semantic controls, SSR-safe core. Release + archive: https://github.com/wpsydev/liquid-glass-kit/releases/tag/v0.9.0-preview.1
